owner: owner decision 2026-10-20 (verbatim in owner-decision-s98-operational-knowledge-path-2026-10-20.md), item 6: 'Then conduct genuinely independent testing when permitted evidence is available'
writtenBefore: any annotation of these pages and any run of the S98 path on them; after fetching only

material.pages: 7 never-examined pages fetched under the standing policy: air purifiers (HouseFresh, 3 reviews) and dishwashers (Yale Appliance, 4 reviews). Both categories are registered and both appear in the 206 regression requests. TechGearLab was planned and refused (self-redirect), not bypassed

path: the operational path itself: Phase245 extraction, Phase265 test leads, Phase269 qualitative codes, the S98 shared scientific reading -> ingestObservation246 into two copies of the live store (gate off = operational baseline and rollback; gate on) -> scientificReadings98 -> adviseFromRequest253 (scientific98 off and on)
items: every quantity with a QK unit in the page's text lines (the reader that finds more quantities, as in S96 amendment 1), deduplicated, evenly sampled, at most 40 per page
annotation: blind Claude-agent annotators who see no system output: per value the property from the operational label set (pd.6 definitions and the QK-metric candidates, with their stated meanings) or 'none'; the conditions the page states for that value as QK axis ids with their values (or 'none stated'); whether it is a result of the reviewed product, of another product, or neither; and its nature (measured by the publisher, declared by a maker, other). Sealed by SHA-256 in evaluation/s98/check-annotation-freeze.json before any run

metrics.quantitativeAttribution: reference values with a property: stored with the correct property (gate on) vs the baseline's stored typed measurand (gate off: test-measurement dimension equal to the property's QK metric); stored with a wrong property; false (reference none, stored with a property)
metrics.conditions: reference values with a stated condition: the stored reading records that axis explicitly; required conditions reported missing
metrics.comparability: verdicts of all cross-product pairs of a property, with the conditions carried and as without the transfer
metrics.productAttribution: stored readings of reference 'reviewed product' values linked to the page's main product; 'other product' values not linked to it
metrics.qualitative: stored judgements reported on the user path (expected few: the qualitative codes cover cooking outcomes only)
metrics.knowledgeReuse: attributions through definitions pd.6 vs QK-metric candidates
metrics.advice: the 206 requests and the air-purifier and dishwasher requests among them: decisions unchanged; answers carrying scientific evidence; comparison verdicts
metrics.resources: milliseconds per page, readings per page

stopRules.promotion: the gated path is recommended for activation only if, on these pages, it adds correct typed attributions without more false or wrong ones than it adds correct ones, keeps conditions it reads explicit, links no 'other product' value to the main product more often than it links correctly, and changes no advice decision
stopRules.otherwise: keep gated, document the causal blocker

notClaimed: no ranking, no recommendation, no promotion of any candidate definition; R3 stays open
